source: Synthetic exact data generated from the Havlena–Odeh equations (SPE-559-PA) with known N and m.
description: Case (c): F = N(Eo + m·Eg) with N = 5e7, m = 0.4 (Efw = 0 as the method assumes); F/Eo vs Eg/Eo must return N and m exactly.
tolerance_justification: Exact data; least squares on a 2-column design with condition number ~1e1–1e2 amplifies rounding to ≤ ~1e-13 relative.
